```{r import data}

ca_cases <- readr::read_csv("data/sim_novelid_CA.csv")
la_cases <- readr::read_csv("data/sim_novelid_LACounty.csv")
ca_pop <- readr::read_csv("data/ca_pop_2023.csv")

```

## Morbidity datasets (from CA and LA County) ##
### Recode discordant column names, values, and formats ###
```{r clean column names}

#snakecase column titles
la_cases <- clean_names(la_cases)
ca_cases <- clean_names(ca_cases)

#tidying la_cases
la_cases_clean <- la_cases %>%
    rename(age_cat = age_category,
           cumulative_infected = infected_cumulative,
           cumulative_unrecovered = unrecovered_cumulative,
           cumulative_severe = severe_cumulative,
           new_severe = severe_new,
           new_unrecovered = unrecovered_new) %>%
  # filling the dt_report column with the dt_dx in epi_week format
    mutate(dt_dx = dmy(dt_dx),
           county = "Los Angeles County", #adding a county column for future merge with ca_cases
           dt_report = gsub("-", "", format(as.Date(aweek::date2week(dt_dx, week_start = "Sunday")), "%Y-%U")))

# making dt_report numeric to match ca_cases
la_cases_clean$dt_report <- as.numeric(la_cases_clean$dt_report)

# tidying ca_cases
 ca_cases_clean <- ca_cases %>%
   rename(race_eth = race_ethnicity,
          dt_dx = dt_diagnosis,
          dx_new = new_infections,
          dt_report = time_int)  %>%
   mutate(race_eth = case_when(
          race_eth == 1 ~ "White, Non-Hispanic",
          race_eth == 2 ~ "Black, Non-Hispanic",
          race_eth == 3 ~ "American Indian or Alaska Native, Non-Hispanic",
          race_eth == 4 ~ "Asian, Non-Hispanic",
          race_eth == 5 ~ "Native Hawaiian or Pacific Islander, Non-Hispanic",
          race_eth == 6 ~ "Multiracial (two or more of above races), Non-Hispanic",
          race_eth == 7 ~ "Hispanic (any race)",
          race_eth == 9 ~ "Unknown",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_))
 
# alphabetizing column names for easier comparison
la_cases_clean <- la_cases_clean %>% select(sort(names(.)))
ca_cases_clean <- ca_cases_clean %>% select(sort(names(.)))

glimpse(la_cases_clean)
glimpse(ca_cases_clean)

# column titles and data types match - ready to merge!

```


### Combine morbidity datasets into a single dataset ###
```{r}

combined_cases <- bind_rows(ca_cases_clean, la_cases_clean)

```

### Select demographic and geographic strata(s) of interest ###
```{r}

#I think this chunk can get deleted because I'm not really sure what to include

```

### Aggregate the data into a new dataframe to include only one row per strata of interest ###
```{r}

aggregated_cases_race <- combined_cases %>%
  group_by(race_eth) %>%
  summarise(
    cumulative_infected = max(cumulative_infected, na.rm = TRUE),
    cumulative_severe = max(cumulative_severe, na.rm = TRUE),
    cumulative_unrecovered = max(cumulative_unrecovered, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

aggregated_cases_county <- combined_cases %>%
  group_by(county) %>%
  summarise(
    cumulative_infected = max(cumulative_infected, na.rm = TRUE),
    cumulative_severe = max(cumulative_severe, na.rm = TRUE),
    cumulative_unrecovered = max(cumulative_unrecovered, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

```


## Population dataset ##
### Recode values to be consistent with morbidity datasets so they can be joined ###
```{r recode for consistency}

ca_pop <- clean_names(ca_pop)

ca_pop_clean <- ca_pop %>%
    rename(race_eth = race7)  %>%
    mutate(race_eth = case_when(
           race_eth == "WhiteTE NH" ~ "White, Non-Hispanic",
           race_eth == "Black NH" ~ "Black, Non-Hispanic",
           race_eth == "AIAN NH" ~ "American Indian or Alaska Native, Non-Hispanic",
           race_eth == "Asian NH" ~ "Asian, Non-Hispanic",
           race_eth == "NHPI NH" ~ "Native Hawaiian or Pacific Islander, Non-Hispanic",
           race_eth == "MR NH" ~ "Multiracial (two or more of above races), Non-Hispanic",
           race_eth == "Hispanic" ~ "Hispanic (any race)",
           TRUE ~ NA_character_))

unique(ca_pop_clean$race_eth)

```

### Select demographic or geogrphic strata(s) of interest ###
```{r demograpgic and geograpgic strata}

county_populations <- ca_pop_clean %>%
  group_by(county) %>%
  summarize(pop = sum(pop, na.rm = TRUE))

ca_race_totals <- ca_pop_clean %>%
  group_by(race_eth) %>%
  summarize(pop = sum(pop, na.rm = TRUE))

county_populations <- county_populations %>%
  mutate(county = paste(county, "County"))

```

### Create a rate metric and summarize to include only one row per strata of interest ###
```{r rate}

cases_by_county <- aggregated_cases_county %>%
  left_join(
    county_populations %>% select(county, pop), 
    by = "county")

cases_by_race <- aggregated_cases_race %>%
  left_join(
    ca_race_totals %>% select(race_eth, pop), 
    by = "race_eth")

cases_by_county <- cases_by_county %>%
  mutate(rate_per_1000 = ((cumulative_infected/pop)*1000),
         severe_rate_per_1000 = ((cumulative_severe/pop)*1000))

cases_by_race <- cases_by_race %>%
  mutate(rate_per_1000 = ((cumulative_infected/pop)*1000),
         severe_rate_per_1000 = ((cumulative_severe/pop)*1000))

```
